about.metaDescription: Meet the photographer. Add a personal introduction and verified details about your experience and approach.
about.title: A Little About Me!
about.intro:
I have always loved being behind the camera capturing the moments that matter most. My favorite part of photography is knowing that the images I create for you will be treasured not only today, but for years to come.

My goal is to give you more than just beautiful photos. I want you to be able to look back at them years from now and be transported right back to that moment—to remember the feelings, the laughter, the love, and all the little details that made that season of life so special.

I have photographs of my own family that mean the world to me, and I know just how priceless those memories become with time.
about.sectionDescription: What started as simply photographing my own family has grown into something so much bigger, and I couldn't be more grateful. It is truly my joy and privilege to capture these special moments for you and your family. Thank you for allowing me to be a small part of your story!
